scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd backend && npx nodemon server.js" "cd frontend && npx vite --port 5173"
scripts.mobile:reverse: adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && adb reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000
scripts.mobile:android: adb reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 2>/dev/null; adb reverse tcp:5000 tcp:5000 2>/dev/null; cd mobile && npx react-native run-android
